final: WITH trans_averages AS (SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, AVG(sf.shortintrt) as avg_shortintrt, AVG(sf.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON sf.transref = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist), order_type_baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(avg_shortintrt) as baseline_shortintrt FROM trans_averages WHERE avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT ta.transreg, ta.ordertypedist, ta.avg_shortintrt, ta.avg_optvolrt, CASE WHEN otb.baseline_shortintrt IS NOT NULL AND otb.baseline_shortintrt != 0 THEN ta.avg_shortintrt / otb.baseline_shortintrt ELSE NULL END as ratio FROM trans_averages ta LEFT JOIN order_type_baselines otb ON ta.ordertypedist = otb.ordertypedist ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
